name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), animation domain, descriptor spell_sprite_offset_table reflects both purpose (per-spell sprite-index base offset) and data type (_table). No Ghidra address residue -- no hex suffix. The 33-element dimension is internal and not encoded in the name.
purpose: Per-spell sprite-index base offset (animation frame base) for the per-target spell-impact animation; one byte per spell_id, added to the running frame index to select the source sprite within the portrait/frame sheet.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target (@0x1C4CC) copies the 33 bytes into a stack scratch via REP MOVSD x8 + MOVSB (@0x1C4E4-0x1C4F4, dst [ESP+0x48]). It indexes the copy by spell_id (EBP, the function arg loaded @0x1C4DD): @0x1C67B MOVZX EAX,byte [ESP+EBP*1+0x48] (stride 1, zero-extended) -> @0x1C680 ADD EAX,frame_idx(EDI) -> @0x1C688 MOV EAX,[EDX+EAX*4+6] picks the 4-byte sprite-frame entry from the sheet base [0x53AD1]. First of three parallel 33-byte byte tables (sprite-offset @0x51F33, frame_count @0x51F54, sfx @0x51F75).
element_semantics: Element i = sprite-index base offset for spell_id i (0..32). The value is added to the per-target impact animation's running frame counter to derive the index into the 4-byte-stride sprite-frame table; a per-spell starting frame within the portrait/frame sheet.
comment_original_issue: Accurate and precise, but the read-only note read 'single READ xref, no writers' whereas its two sibling tables in the same file (frame_count @0x51F54, sfx @0x51F75) read 'single READ xref + the base-address DATA xref, no writers'. The sprite-offset table actually has the same base-address DATA xref (@0x1C4ED MOV ESI,0x51F33), so the prior wording understated the xref set relative to siblings.
notes: Memory bytes @0x51F33 (33B) read back byte-identical to the src array. Disassembly of fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target verified every offset cited in the src comment (REP MOVSD x8 + MOVSB @0x1C4E4-0x1C4F4; MOVZX byte load @0x1C67B; ADD frame_idx @0x1C680; MOV [EDX+EAX*4+6] @0x1C688). Ghidra datatype already byte[33]; Ghidra plate was empty (NULL) so a concise src-derived plate was created. No logic changes made; rename deferred per workflow (verdict keep, nothing to apply).
